# YARA-L community rules

Google's community detection rules from [chronicle/detection-rules](https://github.com/chronicle/detection-rules) at `a49c3752f3f013e9ead85c7430b8f39369efacbf`, Copyright Google LLC, licensed under the Apache License 2.0 ([`../LICENSE.Apache-2.0.txt`](../LICENSE.Apache-2.0.txt)). Each `<name>.yaral` is the file as published, licence header included. Each `<name>.broken.yaral` is a modified copy with one injected fault (an unknown UDM field, a dangling `and` in `condition`, or a misspelled `condition:` label), as Apache-2.0 §4(b) asks us to state. `scripts/sync_yaral_corpus.py` writes both; `crates/opentide-yaral/tests/external_corpus.rs` checks them.

Every sixth rule of `rules/community` in path order, plus one rule for each feature the sample would miss:

- `geoip_user_login_from_multiple_states_or_countries.yaral` from `rules/community/authentication/geoip_user_login_from_multiple_states_or_countries.yaral`
